雷部有隙火部无声（雷部有隙火部无声（第22页）“连条孽龙都看不住，闹得天庭人尽皆知，啧啧。”他斜睨了苏元一眼：“大外甥，你这雷部管的可是一般啊。”苏元下意识便要反驳，这龙不是没看住，是阐教截教内斗，被人趁虚而入；自己也不是管不好雷部，只是积弊几百年，理顺还需要一些时间。话都到嘴边了，他忽然又咽了回去。因为他忽然想起了另一件事，黄龙入主火部，是什么光景？那时候火部正印罗宣被陛下一脚踢开，雷部派驻组磨刀霍霍，一声令下就准备拿火部开刀。整个火部上下群龙无首，副部长各怀心思，下面的仙官力士更是一盘散沙。自己好歹上有太师帮衬，下有崇应鸾这个得力干将，中间有辛环这帮老兄弟撑着场面，也有在雷部当司长时攒下的工作经验。可就算是这样，自己这几天还是焦头烂额，心力交瘁。黄龙孤身一人入主火部，他虽然是阐教十二金仙，说着是好听，不过谁不知道他是三界公认的“不胜传说”。但苏元搜肠刮肚地想了半天，竟想不起火部这些年闹出过什么大动静，当年整个火部就像是一潭死水，平平静静，稳稳当当。黄龙难得收了嬉笑，转过身来，伸手在苏元肩上拍了拍。“年轻一代，你是走得最快，走得最远的。”“现在朝中支持你的人不少，但想看你热闹，摘你桃子的人更多。”苏元没有接话，他还在消化这句话的分量。“你要学会靠自己。不要再指望我，不要再指望闻仲，不要再指望太白金星。我们能替你挡风遮雨的日子，已经过去了。”“用你的话来讲，一代人有一代人要做的事。三界暗潮涌动，我们这些老东西，如今压力也不轻啊。”黄龙再次用脚拨弄者地上那颗龙头，院墙外，夜空暗沉，星河低垂，云海翻涌，远处隐隐有雷声滚过，不知是哪个部洲又在下雨。“龙族，嗤。”“干大事而惜身，见小利而忘命。当年跟着东皇太一打巫族的时候是这样，后来跟着陛下扫荡妖族的时候还是这样。”苏元望着那个正用脚尖漫不经心地拨弄龙头的瘦削背影，心里忽然涌上一股寒意。黄龙是龙。如今三界龙族，隐隐以黄龙为尊，因为比他老的，没有他活跃，比他活跃的，没有他老。如今好不容易有几条老龙刚从龙冢里爬出来，便被自己兜头拿了。跑了一条龙出去，自己都没太当回事，不过是丢了个犯人罢了，可黄龙却连夜追上去，把那条逃出去的老龙宰了。自己这人畜无害，整日嘻了马哈的老舅，也是个狠角色啊，杀了这条老龙，如今三界龙族，还是以他为尊。黄龙却像是没看见他脸上的震动似的，又恢复了那副吊儿郎当的模样。笑嘻嘻地从苏元腰间储物囊里摸出一根好烟夹在耳朵上，又摸了一根叼在嘴里，也不点，就这么叼着，含含糊糊地道：“行了，正事儿说完了。还有一桩闲事，顺道跟你提一嘴。”苏元还没回过神来，只是下意识地“嗯”了一声。“下月初一，通明殿朝会。陛下遨游太虚，许旌阳陪同，不会参加。”“南极请假，也不会参加。”“紫薇帝君主持。闻仲、东华两位帝君，诸位天级、副天级干部都会列席。”“这是你上任雷部之后的头一次大朝会，四御里头来三个，天级副天级坐了满殿。你这一关，不好过。”他顿了顿，意味深长地看了苏元一眼。“是真正执掌雷部，还是当个笑柄，你自己好好把握。”

There is a gap in the thunder department, but the fire department is silent (Page 22) "I can't even stand the evil dragon, and everyone in heaven knows about it, tsk tsk." He glanced sideways at Su Yuan: "Great nephew, you are in charge of the thunder department. Just average." Su Yuan subconsciously wanted to retort. It's not that the dragon didn't notice, it was because of the infighting between the Chan and Jie sects, and someone took advantage of it. It's not that he couldn't manage the Lei Department, but it's just that it's been going on for hundreds of years, and it will take some time to straighten it out. When it reached his mouth, he suddenly swallowed it back because he suddenly remembered another thing. What was it like when Huang Long took over the Fire Department? At that time, Luo Xuan, the leader of the Fire Department, was kicked away by his Majesty. As soon as the order was given, the Fire Department was ready to attack. The entire Fire Department was leaderless, the deputy ministers had their own ideas, and the immortal officials below were in disarray. , there are old brothers like Xin Huan in the middle to support the situation, and they also have the work experience gained when they were the directors of the Lei Department. But even so, Huang Long is still exhausted these days, and he is alone in taking charge of the Fire Department. Although he was the Twelve Golden Immortal, which sounded nice, but no one knew that he was a "legend" recognized by the three worlds. But Su Yuan thought about it for a long time, and he couldn't remember what big commotion the Fire Department had made in recent years. Back then, the entire Fire Department was like a pool of stagnant water. Huang Long stopped laughing, turned around, and patted Su Yuan on the shoulder. "Young people, you are the fastest and the furthest." "Now there are many people in the government who support you, but they want to see you lively and pick your peaches." Su Yuan did not answer, he was still digesting the weight of this sentence. "You have to learn to rely on yourself. Don't count on me anymore. Don't. Look to Wen Zhong again, don't look to Taibai Jinxing anymore. The days when we can protect you from wind and rain are over. "In your words, one generation has something to do. The undercurrent of the Three Realms is surging, and we old guys are under great pressure now." Outside the courtyard wall, the night sky was dark, the stars were drooping, the sea of clouds was rolling, and there was a faint sound of thunder in the distance. Yu. "Dragon clan, scoff." "You cherish your life when you do big things, and you forget your life when you see small gains. It was like this when I followed Donghuang Taiyi to fight against the Witch Clan, and it was still like this when I followed His Majesty to wipe out the Monster Clan." Su Yuan looked at the right man. The thin back of the dragon head was carelessly played with his toes, and a chill suddenly came to his heart. Huang Long is a dragon in the Three Realms. Huang Long is vaguely respected because those older than him are not as active as him. Not as old as him. Nowadays, a few old dragons have just crawled out of the Dragon Tomb, and they have been taken away by me. I don't take it seriously, but I just lost a prisoner, but Huang Long did it overnight. He chased after him and killed the old dragon that had escaped. He was a harmless old uncle who had been messing around all day long, but he was also a ruthless character. After killing this old dragon, Huang Long still seemed to respect him. As if he didn't see the shock on his face, he returned to his carefree look. He smiled and took out a good cigarette from the storage bag at Su Yuan's waist and clamped it to his ear, then took another one and held it in his mouth without lighting it. Holding it in his mouth, he said vaguely: "Okay, let's finish talking about the business. I have one more casual thing to mention to you." Su Yuan hadn't recovered yet, so he just said "hmm" subconsciously, "On the first day of the next lunar month, we will go to the Tongming Palace.meeting. His Majesty is traveling in Taixu, and Xu Jingyang is accompanying him and will not participate. "If Antarctica asks for leave, she will not participate." "The Emperor Ziwei is in charge." The two emperors Wen Zhong and Donghua, as well as all heaven-level and deputy heaven-level cadres will be present. "This is the first big court meeting since you took office in the Lei Department. Three of the four emperors came, and the whole hall was filled with the heaven-level and deputy heaven-level ministers." This is a difficult time for you. He paused and gave Su Yuan a meaningful look. "Whether you are really in charge of the Lei Department or you are a laughing stock, you have to decide for yourself." "
